prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your Custom Pet to Your Account", "Sign in now to lock in your pet customization and ensure your desktop pet is safely backed up."]
1: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Review your new companion's details and confirm adoption to bring them to your desktop."]
2: ["Ready to Meet Your Companion!", "Here is a quick overview of how to interact, minimize, or talk to your pet on your desktop.", "Master your desktop pet controls"]
3: ["Find Your Ideal Companion Path", "Answer two quick questions to match with the perfect pet adoption experience."]
4: ["Sign In to Secure & Restore Your Pets", "Creating or signing into your account ensures your pets and customizations are safely saved to the cloud and never lost."]
5: ["Don't worry! You can fine-tune or regenerate your pet's appearance anytime for free.", "Unlimited Fine-Tuning Guarantee"]
6: ["Select Your Pet Journey", "Choose how you would like to create or pick your desktop pet companion."]
7: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Right-click your pet for controls, double-click to chat, or click the tray icon to hide/show anytime."]
8: ["Tip: Use the same email or login provider you used previously to access all your existing pets instantly."]
9: ["We will play a quick chime and alert you as soon as your desktop pet is ready to appear.", "Chime when pet is ready"]
